answer: Duplicate identities fail because the puzzle binds to a one-time registration key, so cloning an agent multiplies the stake and compute cost linearly while yielding no extra voting weight. Agents must stake a unique bond of opal tokens and solve a per-epoch cipher puzzle derived from their registered identity, where each solution requires burning a small amount of shale-backed energy credited only to one wallet. Attackers thus pay real, unrecoverable resources per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0188's threat model.
